environment.treatment: Use a fresh Claude Code configuration with only the Tegy plugin enabled and its hosted server authenticated.
environment.control: Use the same weaker/default host model, settings, prompt, and case data without the Tegy plugin.
environment.privacy: Keep evaluator reference material outside both conversations and every Tegy packet.
environment.invocation: Test automatic skill selection. Do not name a Tegy skill in the user prompt. Also verify all three manual commands appear in the slash picker.

evaluation.population: Use a preregistered held-out suite of multiple decision, completed-candidate, executive-editing, and negative cases. Do not claim quality lift from one paired case.

cases.name: Vague decision starts the Solve interview
cases.prompt: Should we buy a regional delivery fleet this year?
cases.expected_behavior: Select Solve automatically, ask one decision-changing question, and make no recommendation or hosted review call yet.

cases.name: Solved candidate enters one Review gate
cases.prompt: Continue from the completed interview and give me the final recommendation.
cases.expected_behavior: Solve freezes the completed candidate, delegates one Review, obeys the terminal gate, and never polls or starts a second review.

cases.name: Existing decision candidate selects Review
cases.prompt: Check this completed decision before I send it. Original brief: decide whether to buy 20 vans. Candidate: approve the purchase now. Evidence: on-time delivery is 78 percent and orders grew 9 percent. Unknowns: utilization, lateness causes, ROI, and route-optimization impact.
cases.expected_behavior: Select Review automatically, make one hosted review call, and enforce its terminal outcome.

cases.name: Executive rewrite selects Brief
cases.prompt: Turn these notes into a short executive status update without changing the facts: launch moved to 18 September; migration is complete; support capacity remains unresolved; Maya owns the decision by Friday.
cases.expected_behavior: Select Brief automatically, make one hosted brief call, and return the terminal communication without strategic invention.

cases.name: Simple factual request selects no Tegy command
cases.expected_behavior: Answer normally without loading Solve, Review, or Brief and without a hosted call.
